findings.observed: Aucuns frais ne s'appliquent au remboursement anticipé.
findings.expected: Aucuns frais -> Aucun frais ne s'applique au remboursement anticipé. (ou: Aucuns frais ... is non-standard; use "Aucun frais ne s'applique")
findings.description: "Aucuns frais" is a grammatical error; standard usage is "Aucun frais".
The recalculate button (testid calculator-recalculate-button) is labelled with the page title instead of an action; the English has the same flaw.
Due date and transaction dates are shown in raw ISO format, unlike the localized "16 septembre 2026" on the confirmation page.
